altText: Cover slide with a photo (a manager texting on a phone); text: Reviews za gym yako tayari zinaandikwa. Si mahali unapoweza kuzisoma. Your gym’s reviews are already being written. Just not where you can read them.
Text slide; text: WhatsApp. Bajaji. Chumba cha kubadilishia. WhatsApp groups, taxi rides, the changing room. That’s where members review you today.
Text slide; text: Kwa FitFlex, waliofanya mazoezi kwako wanatoa review ndani ya app. On FitFlex, members who trained at your gym review it in the app.
Checklist slide; text: Mwanachama anaona hivi kabla ya kukuchagua.; Rows: Verified badge and tier (FitFlex), Member reviews (in app), Check-in by QR (60 s), Pay by mobile money (M-Pesa · Airtel)

Photo slide with a photo (a smiling man with crossed arms in a gym); text: Anayefuata anasoma reviews zako kabla ya kukuchagua. The next member reads your reviews before choosing you. A bad one tells you what to fix this week.
Text slide; text: Unasoma kila review kama mmiliki. Unajulishwa inapoingia. You read every review as the owner. You’re told when one lands.
Text slide; text: Sifa ilikuwa bahati. Sasa ni data. Reputation used to be luck. Now it’s data.
Call to action; text: Una gym Dar es Salaam? Andika; Keyword PARTNER. Tutakutumia DM jinsi FitFlex inavyofanya kazi. · We’ll DM you how FitFlex works.
